677	/** LihzahrdAltar 终保 pass（cs:21753-21791 1:1）：重放祭坛 6 格 + 正下方三格
678	 *  强制 226 地板（slope/halfBrick/liquid 复位）——原版注册序在 TileCleanup(21327)

681	export function runLihzahrdAltarPass(st: TileStore, gs: GenState): void {
682	  const altarX = gs.lAltarX, altarY = gs.lAltarY;
683	  if (altarX < 0) return;   // 无神庙世界（Skyblock 等）跳过
684	  for (let dx = 0; dx <= 2; dx++) {
685	    for (let dy = 0; dy <= 1; dy++) {
686	      if (st.inBounds(altarX + dx, altarY + dy)) {
687	        st.setTileSilent(altarX + dx, altarY + dy, ALTAR, dx * 18, dy * 18);
688	      }
689	    }
690	    const bj = st.inBounds(altarX + dx, altarY + 2) ? st.idx(altarX + dx, altarY + 2) : -1;
691	    if (bj >= 0) {
692	      st.type[bj] = BRICK; st.flags[bj] = 1;
693	      st.slope[bj] = 0; st.half[bj] = 0; st.liquid[bj] = 0;
694	    }
695	  }
696	}

840	/** PlaceTile(105, style)（神庙雕像）：2×3，锚点=底行左列的下一格语义（与 StatuesPass 一致） */
841	function placeStatueTemple(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
842	  const STATUE = TILE_BY_KEY['v_105_statue'];
843	  if (STATUE === undefined) return false;
844	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
845	    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
846	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
847	    }
848	  }
849	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
850	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
851	      // 雕像帧 55 列换行（cs:39716-39720；神庙 style 43-45 <55 本可不过防御性同款）
852	      const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
853	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, STATUE, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
854	    }
855	  }
856	  return true;
857	}

859	/** PlaceTile(240, style)（神庙墙挂饰）：3×3，帧基 = (style%36)*54 / floor(style/36)*54 */
860	function placeWallHangingTemple(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
861	  const HANGING = TILE_BY_KEY['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3'];
862	  if (HANGING === undefined) return false;
863	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) {
864	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
865	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
866	    }
867	  }
868	  const bx = (style % 36) * 54;
869	  const bys = Math.floor(style / 36) * 54;
870	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) {
871	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
872	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y + dy, HANGING, bx + dx * 18, bys + dy * 18);
873	    }
874	  }
875	  return true;
876	}

878	/** 玛雅陷阱(WorldGen.cs:2945-3235):压板 135(style6)→ 陷阱 137,路径铺三色随机导线 */
879	function mayanTrap(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, x2: number, y2: number): boolean {
880	  const PLATE = TILE_BY_KEY['v_135_pressure_plates']!;
881	  const TRAP = TILE_BY_KEY['v_137_traps']!;
882	  const solid = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] !== 0;
883	  const wireBit = (n: number) => n === 0 ? TileStore.WIRE_RED : n === 1 ? TileStore.WIRE_BLUE : TileStore.WIRE_GREEN;
884	  const setW = (x: number, y: number, n: number) => { st.wire[st.idx(x, y)] |= wireBit(n); };
885	  const getW = (x: number, y: number) => {
886	    const b = st.wire[st.idx(x, y)];
887	    if (b & TileStore.WIRE_RED) return 0;
888	    if (b & TileStore.WIRE_BLUE) return 1;
889	    if (b & TileStore.WIRE_GREEN) return 2;
890	    return -1;
891	  };
892	  const pickColor = (x: number, y: number) => {
893	    const ex = getW(x, y);
894	    return ex >= 0 ? ex : rng.int(0, 2);
895	  };
896	  // num1:1/3 概率横向(L2947-2949)
897	  const kind = rng.int(0, 2) === 0 ? 0 : 1;
898	  // 落点向下找实心(L2950-2962)
899	  const px = x2;
900	  let fy = y2;
901	  while (!solid(px, fy)) {
902	    fy++;
903	    if (fy >= st.h - 300) return false;
904	  }
905	  const sh = TILE_BY_KEY['v_226_lihzahrd_brick']!;
906	  if (st.type[st.idx(px, fy)] === sh || TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(px, fy)]]?.vanilla?.sheet === 10) return false;
907	  const j = fy - 1;
908	  if (st.liquid[st.idx(px, j)] > 0 && st.liquidType[st.idx(px, j)] === 2) return false;
909	  // 周围须净空(L2967)
910	  const nactive = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] !== 0;
911	  if (nactive(px, j) || nactive(px - 1, j) || nactive(px + 1, j) || nactive(px, j - 1)
912	    || nactive(px - 1, j - 1) || nactive(px + 1, j - 1) || nactive(px, j - 2)
913	    || nactive(px - 1, j - 2) || nactive(px + 1, j - 2)) return false;
914	
915	  if (kind === 0) {
916	    // 横向:同高走廊两端墙装飞镖陷阱,压板居中(L2971-3119)
917	    const ty = j - rng.int(0, 2);
918	    let lx = px;
919	    while (!solid(lx, ty)) lx--;
920	    let rx = px;
921	    while (!solid(rx, ty)) rx++;
922	    let flagL = (px - lx) > 5 && (px - lx) < 50 && solid(lx, ty + 1);
923	    let flagR = (rx - px) > 5 && (rx - px) < 50 && solid(rx, ty + 1);
924	    if (!flagL && !flagR) return false;
925	    let dir: number, tx: number;
926	    if (flagL && flagR) {

102	  const ids35 = new Map<number, number>();
103	  for (let q = 0; q < iw.length; q += 2) ids35.set(iw[q]!, iw[q + 1]!);
104	  const chests = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${dir}/chests.json`, 'utf8')) as unknown[];
105	  const b: Boundary = { gs, gensolid, fx, fy, wire, ids35, chests };
106	  bCache.set(key, b);
107	  return b;
108	}

110	interface PrevOut { type: Uint16Array; flags: Uint8Array; fx: Uint16Array; fy: Uint16Array; wire: Uint8Array }
111	function buildHybrid(baseIdx: number, b: Boundary | PrevOut): { st: TileStore; revMiss: number } {
112	  const c = chans(baseIdx);
113	  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
114	  const fromB = 'ids35' in b;
115	  const ids35 = fromB ? (b as Boundary).ids35 : null;
116	  let revMiss = 0;
117	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
118	    const act = c.a[i]!;
119	    st.flags[i] = act;
120	    if (act || c.t[i]) {
121	      const sh = c.t[i]!;
122	      let id = ids35 && ids35.has(i) ? ids35.get(i)! : -1;
123	      if (id < 0 || SHEET[id] !== sh) { id = REV.get(sh) ?? -1; }
124	      if (id < 0) { id = 0; revMiss++; }
125	      st.type[i] = id;
126	    } else st.type[i] = 0;
127	    st.wall[i] = c.w[i]!;
128	    st.liquid[i] = c.l[i]!;
129	    st.liquidType[i] = c.l[i] ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
130	    st.half[i] = c.hf[i]!;
131	    st.slope[i] = c.sl[i]!;
132	    st.wire[i] = c.ia[i]! ? 0x20 : 0;
133	    if (fromB) {
134	      const bb = b as Boundary;
135	      st.frameX[i] = bb.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = bb.fy[i];
136	      st.wire[i] |= bb.wire[i];
137	    } else {
138	      const p = b as PrevOut;
139	      st.frameX[i] = p.fx[i]; st.frameY[i] = p.fy[i];
140	      st.wire[i] |= p.wire[i] & 0x1f;
141	    }
142	  }
143	  return { st, revMiss };
144	}
145	const prevOf = (st: TileStore): PrevOut => ({ type: st.type.slice(), flags: st.flags.slice(), fx: st.frameX.slice(), fy: st.frameY.slice(), wire: st.wire.slice() });

147	// ---- 八通道 diff（_mile8 cmp 口径）----
148	interface Row { idx: number; tag: string; dA: number; dT: number; dW: number; dL: number; dHf: number; dSl: number; dLt: number; dIa: number; first: string; pairs: Array<[string, number]>; samples: string[] }
149	function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {
150	  const c = chans(idx);
151	  const r: Row = { idx, tag, dA: 0, dT: 0, dW: 0, dL: 0, dHf: 0, dSl: 0, dLt: 0, dIa: 0, first: '', pairs: [], samples: [] };
152	  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
153	  let firstI = -1;
154	  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
155	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
156	    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
157	    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
158	    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
159	    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
160	    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
161	    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
162	    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
163	    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
164	    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
165	    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
166	    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
167	    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
168	    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
169	    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
170	    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
171	  }
172	  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
173	  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
174	  return r;
175	}
176	const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
177	function printRow(r: Row): void {
178	  const bad = !isClean(r);
179	  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
180	    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
181	    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
182	  if (bad) {
183	    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
184	    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
185	  }
186	}

197	/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
198	function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
199	  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
200	  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
201	  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
202	  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
203	  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
204	  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
205	  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
206	  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
207	  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
208	}

210	async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
211	  world.store = st;
212	  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
213	  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
214	  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
215	  else {
216	    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
217	    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
218	      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
219	      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
220	  }
221	  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
222	  flipGenSolid([484], false);
223	}

218	/** IsTileNearby（cs:8828）：±distance 盒内找 active 同型格（type≠235 时步长 1） */
219	function isTileNearby(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, sheet: number, distance: number): boolean {
220	  const target = sheetId(sheet);
221	  for (let i = x - distance; i <= x + distance; i++) {
222	    for (let j = y - distance; j <= y + distance; j++) {
223	      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;
224	      const ii = st.idx(i, j);
225	      if (st.flags[ii] && st.type[ii] === target) return true;
226	    }
227	  }
228	  return false;
229	}
230	/** AreAnyTilesInSetNearby（cs:8753）：±distance 盒内找集合内 active 格 */
231	function anyBoulderNearby(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, distance: number): boolean {
232	  for (let i = x - distance; i <= x + distance; i++) {
233	    for (let j = y - distance; j <= y + distance; j++) {
234	      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;
235	      const ii = st.idx(i, j);
236	      if (st.flags[ii] && isBoulderType(st.type[ii])) return true;

238	  }

241	/** closeEnoughToSpidersToSpawnSpiderBoulder（cs:8796）：±80 步 3 扫墙 62 */
242	function closeSpiders(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {

246	    }
247	  }

250	/** closeEnoughToDungeonToSpawnGhoulder（cs:8772）：地牢侧门 + ±1000 步 10 扫地牢墙 */
251	function closeDungeon(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, side: number): boolean {
252	  if (side <= -1 && x > st.w / 2) return false;
253	  if (side >= 1 && x < st.w / 2) return false;
254	  for (let i = x - 1000; i <= x + 1000; i += 10) {

256	      if (st.inBounds(i, j) && WALL_DUNGEON.has(st.wall[st.idx(i, j)])) return true;
257	    }

261	/** closeEnoughToLavaToSpawnLavaBoulder（cs:8812）：±60 步 3 扫岩浆 */
262	function closeLava(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {

264	    for (let j = y - 60; j <= y + 60; j += 3) {
265	      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;

273	/** L 形布线（先 x 后 y；cs:9124-9147 同构） */
274	function lWire(st: TileStore, x0: number, y0: number, x1: number, y1: number): void {
275	  let wx = x0, wy = y0;
276	  while (wx !== x1 || wy !== y1) {
277	    st.wire[st.idx(wx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
278	    if (wx > x1) wx--; else if (wx < x1) wx++;
279	    st.wire[st.idx(wx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
280	    if (wy > y1) wy--; else if (wy < y1) wy++;
281	    st.wire[st.idx(wx, wy)] |= WIRE_RED;
282	  }
283	}

285	/** PlaceTile(i,j,135,style)（Place1x1 cs:45194：InWorld2 + 地基 SolidTile2 + 本格须空；
286	 *  135 非 IsAMechanism，机构门恒过）。门不过=无板（无掷骰副作用——style 已由调用方掷）。 */
287	function placePlate(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): boolean {
288	  if (x < 2 || y < 2 || x > st.w - 3 || y > st.h - 3) return false;   // InWorld(x,y,2)
289	  if (st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] !== 0) return false;                     // Place1x1 !tile.active()
290	  if (!solidTile2V(st, x, y + 1)) return false;
291	  st.setTileSilent(x, y, PLATE, 0, style * 18);
292	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
293	  st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0;                                    // PlaceTile 前奏 Clear（cs:59497）
294	  // case 135 尾 SquareTileFrame(i,j)（cs:60162-60163）——失活格清 half/slope 支
295	  //   （TileFrame cs:82078-82082，零掷零杀；活性格帧派发本种子零命中）。PPPP 补
296	  //   （曾缺 → (3952,861) 板 (3953,860) 邻帧本应清的失活残坡 s2 存活）
297	  for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
298	    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
299	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy)) continue;
300	      const ni = st.idx(x + dx, y + dy);
301	      if (!st.flags[ni]) { st.half[ni] = 0; st.slope[ni] = 0; }
302	    }
303	  }
304	  return true;
305	}

export function placeFurn(st: TileStore, cx: number, anchorY: number, tile: number, style: number, anchor: 'bottom' | 'top' = 'bottom', flip = 1, support = true, styleRowH?: number, styleColW?: number): boolean {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return false;
  const fw = def.vanilla?.fw ?? def.w ?? 1;
  const fh = def.vanilla?.fh ?? def.h ?? 1;
  const x0 = cx - Math.floor(fw / 2);
  const yTop = anchor === 'bottom' ? anchorY - fh + 1 : anchorY;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + dy)]) return false;
    }
  }
  if (anchor === 'bottom' && support) {
    for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + fh) || !st.flags[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + fh)]
        || !TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + fh)]]?.solid) return false;
    }
  }
  const sheet = TILE_DEFS[tile]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
  // 权威布局表(FurnitureStyle.ts,TileObjectData+贴图实测):表内 sheet 直接用,
  // 表外尊重调用参数(竖排 styleRowH / 横排列步 styleColW),最终回退通用横排。
  // 15/139/187 曾漏登记→椅子全落通用横排回退而实为竖排(神庙木椅 2026-08-12),
  // 已补全与 FurnitureStyle.ts 覆盖面同步
  const inTable = [42, 33, 49, 34, 100, 93, 91, 240, 241, 242, 245, 246, 15, 139, 187, 79, 90].includes(sheet);
  let bx: number, by: number;
  if (inTable) [bx, by] = furnitureStyleBase(sheet, style, fw);
  else if (styleRowH !== undefined) { bx = 0; by = style * styleRowH; }
  else { bx = style * (styleColW ?? fw * 18); by = 0; }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      const fx = flip < 0 ? fw - 1 - dx : dx;
      st.setTileSilent(x0 + dx, yTop + dy, tile, bx + fx * 18, by + dy * 18);
      // PlaceTile 前奏清坡（WorldGen.cs:59499-59501 !active → Clear(Slope)）；目标格
      // 已全量校验 inactive（见上）——EE 批清坡收口（X 批 Temple 同族）
      const ci = st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + dy);
      st.slope[ci] = 0; st.half[ci] = 0;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/** 家具水平镜像(帧 X 翻转:桌椅等 1-3 宽物件整体 +18*fw) */
export function flipFurn(st: TileStore, cx: number, floorY: number, tile: number): void {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return;
  const fw = def.vanilla?.fw ?? def.w ?? 1;
  const fh = def.vanilla?.fh ?? def.h ?? 1;
  const x0 = cx - Math.floor(fw / 2);
  const yTop = floorY - fh + 1;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, yTop + dy)) continue;
      const i = st.idx(x0 + dx, yTop + dy);
      if (st.type[i] === tile) st.frameX[i] += fw * 18;
    }
  }
}

/** 墙饰(画/骨/挂毯):顶行=topY,锚点左上;须净空 */
function placeWallArt(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, tile: number, style: number): void {
  const def = TILE_DEFS[tile];
  if (!def) return;

  const fh = def.vanilla?.fh ?? def.h ?? 1;
  const sheet = def.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
  const x0 = x - Math.floor(fw / 2);

    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {

  //  241(4×3):竖排行 54(wrap0 单列)
  //  242(324×1944):竖排 27 行×72,wrap27 → 超 27 换右列 108
  let bx: number, by: number;
  if (sheet === 240) { bx = (style % 36) * 54; by = Math.floor(style / 36) * 54; }
  else if (sheet === 241) { bx = 0; by = style * 54; }
  else if (sheet === 242) { bx = Math.floor(style / 27) * 108; by = (style % 27) * 72; }
  else { bx = style * fw * 18; by = 0; }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < fw; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < fh; dy++) {

  }

	public ushort[] CreateUshortSet(ushort defaultState, params ushort[] inputs)
	{
		if (inputs.Length % 2 != 0)
		{
			throw new Exception("You have a bad length for inputs on CreateArraySet");
		}
		ushort[] ushortBuffer = GetUshortBuffer();
		for (int i = 0; i < ushortBuffer.Length; i++)
		{
			ushortBuffer[i] = defaultState;
		}
		for (int j = 0; j < inputs.Length; j += 2)
		{
			ushortBuffer[inputs[j]] = inputs[j + 1];
		}
		return ushortBuffer;
	}

        public static void WriteGrid(string p, int W, int H, Terraria.Tile[,] tile)
        {
            int n = W * H;
            byte[] typ = new byte[n * 2];
            byte[] act = new byte[n];
            byte[] wal = new byte[n * 2];
            byte[] liq = new byte[n];
            string hs = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_HS_DUMP");
            byte[] half = hs == null ? null : new byte[n];
            byte[] slope = hs == null ? null : new byte[n];
            byte[] lty = hs == null ? null : new byte[n];

                    ushort ty2 = t.type;
                    typ[i * 2] = (byte)(ty2 & 0xFF);
                    typ[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(ty2 >> 8);
                    act[i] = t.active() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                    ushort wv = t.wall;
                    wal[i * 2] = (byte)(wv & 0xFF);
                    wal[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(wv >> 8);
                    liq[i] = t.liquid;
                    if (hs != null)
                    {
                        half[i] = t.halfBrick() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                        slope[i] = (byte)t.slope();
                        lty[i] = (byte)t.liquidType();
                        ina[i] = t.inActive() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                    }
                }
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".typ", typ);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".act", act);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".wal", wal);
            File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".liq", liq);
            if (hs != null)
            {
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".half", half);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".slope", slope);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".lty", lty);
                File.WriteAllBytes(p + ".inact", ina);
            }
        }

 *  Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors:true) 的所有 Gen 步骤，其邻帧 WorldGen.TileFrame

 *  下方祭坛格 → Check3x2(26) 支撑失守 → KillTile×6 整坛坍塌（12345 链 #47 债）。
 *  - 'clearTile'：WorldUtils.ClearTile（cs:55-64）——先清本格（调用方自理）再四邻
 *    +x/-x/+y/-y，resetFrame=false；
 *  - 'setTile'：WorldUtils.TileFrame（cs:79-92）——中心 resetFrame=true 在前，
 *    四邻 resetFrame=true 在后。 */
export function genFrameNeighbors(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG,
  x: number, y: number,
  mode: 'clearTile' | 'setTile',
): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  if (mode === 'clearTile') {
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  } else {
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, true);
    tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, true);
  }
}

/** SquareTileFrame 生成期（cs:80924，九宫、仅中心 resetFrame=true）——
 *  FrameOutAllHiveContents 的 tile 侧等消费端（cs:22544 同构邻格击杀级联） */
export function genSquareTileFrame(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  const ctx: SweepCtx = { rng, destroyObject: false, frameSparse: false, stats: undefined };
  squareTileFrame(st, ctx, x, y);
}

const roll3 = (ctx: SweepCtx): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.roll184++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(0, 2) : 0;
};
const rollRange = (ctx: SweepCtx, min: number, maxIncl: number): number => {
  if (ctx.stats) ctx.stats.rollsOther++;
  return ctx.rng ? ctx.rng.int(min, maxIncl) : min;
};

/** TileFrame 生成期（cs:82067） */
function tileFrameGen(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, _reset: boolean): void {
  // 边距 5 早退（cs:82070）；!active 清 half/slope/块漆早退（cs:82078-82082，
  // ClearBlockPaintAndCoating——RRRR 补块漆清）
  if (x <= 5 || y <= 5 || x >= st.w - 5 || y >= st.h - 5) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) { st.half[i] = 0; st.slope[i] = 0; st.paint[i] = 0; return; }
  const sheet = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  if (sheet < 0) return;
  if (frameImportantDispatch(st, ctx, x, y, sheet)) return;
  // 非实心非 frameImportant：仙人掌 / 藤（cs:82102-82117）
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d?.solid) {
    if (sheet === 80) { if (checkCactusSweep(st, ctx, x, y)) return; }
    else if (IS_VINE.has(sheet)) { checkVinesSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return; }
  }
}

/** TileFrameImportant 分派（cs:85703+）——返回 true=已处理（含 no-op 族） */
function frameImportantDispatch(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number, sheet: number): boolean {

    sheet === 165 || sheet === 185 || sheet === 28 || sheet === 653 || sheet === 240
    || sheet === 440 || sheet === 485 || sheet === 72 || C3X2_TYPES.has(sheet))) {
    return true;
  }
  switch (sheet) {
    case 518: checkLilyPadSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 519: checkCatTailSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 549: checkSeaweedSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 571: checkBambooSweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 72: frame72Sweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 184: frame184Sweep(st, ctx, x, y); return true;
    case 165:

      // （击杀级联的邻格 184 等须掷骰重查——彼时 165-only 的 frame165 不再等价）
      if (ctx.rng) {
        checkStalactite(st, ctx.rng, x, y, (s2, _r, xx, yy) => tileFrameGen(s2, ctx, xx, yy, false));
      }
      return true;
    case 3: case 24: case 61: case 71: case 73: case 74:
    case 110: case 113: case 201: case 637: case 703:
      plantCheckSweep(st, ctx, x, y, sheet); return true;
    case 13: case 33: case 49: case 50: case 78: case 174: case 372: case 646: case 707:

// 注意 `(crc ^ c) & 0xFF` 只取 char 低字节）。Crc32 结果可为负，直接作种子。
export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);
    this.setSeed(seed);
  }

  setSeed(seed: number): void {

    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);

    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;

      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }

      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  /** C# Sample（:63-65）*/
  private sample(): number {
    return this.internalSample() * 4.656612875245797e-10;

//   家具大族（358-364 等，见 FURNITURE_DUST）→Next(3)。
/** KillTile_GetTileDustAmount（cs:66654，fail=false 档） */
function killTileDustAmount(sheet: number, fx: number): number {
  if (sheet === 654 || sheet === 630 || sheet === 631) return 0;
  if (sheet === 125 || sheet === 138 || sheet === 172 || sheet === 287
    || (sheet >= 300 && sheet <= 308) || sheet === 354 || sheet === 355
    || (sheet >= 373 && sheet <= 376) || sheet === 461 || sheet === 484 || sheet === 499
    || sheet === 564 || sheet === 565 || sheet === 593 || sheet === 594 || sheet === 617
    || sheet === 664 || sheet === 665 || sheet === 699 || sheet === 709
    || (sheet >= 711 && sheet <= 716)) return 0;
  if (sheet === 231) return 6;
  if (sheet >= 481 && sheet <= 483) return 3;
  if (sheet === 541) return 1;
  if (sheet === 549) return 2;
  if (sheet === 534 || sheet === 536 || sheet === 539 || sheet === 625 || sheet === 627) return 5;
  if (sheet === 184) return Math.floor(fx / 22) >= 5 ? 5 : 10;
  return 10;
}
/** MakeTileDust 每调的 genRand 掷（cs:66744+ num 择取掷，实测表见上） */
const FURNITURE_DUST = new Set([
  358, 359, 360, 361, 362, 363, 364, 275, 276, 277, 278, 279, 280, 281, 282, 285, 286,
  288, 289, 290, 291, 292, 293, 294, 295, 296, 297, 316, 317, 318, 298, 299, 309, 310,
  339, 538, 413, 414, 505, 521, 522, 523, 524, 525, 526, 527, 532, 543, 544, 550, 551,
  533, 553, 554, 555, 556, 558, 559, 542, 391, 392, 393, 394, 568, 569, 570, 582, 580,
  598, 599, 600, 601, 602, 603, 604, 605, 606, 607, 608, 609, 610, 611, 612, 619, 620,
  629, 632, 640, 643, 644, 645, 710,
]);
function makeTileDustRoll(ctx: SweepCtx, sheet: number, fx: number): void {
  if (!ctx.rng) return;
  const r = ctx.rng;
  switch (sheet) {
    case 2: case 477: case 27: case 243: case 244: case 204: case 478:
    case 641: case 370: case 171:
      r.nextInt(2);
      return;
    case 26: case 695:
      if (fx < 54) r.nextInt(2);
      return;
    case 583: case 584: case 585: case 586: case 587: case 588: case 589:
      r.nextInt(10);
      return;
    case 633:
      r.nextInt(6);
      return;
    case 634:
      r.nextInt(10);
      r.nextInt(12);
      return;
    case 238:
      r.nextInt(3);
      return;
    case 385:
      r.nextIntRange(68, 71);
      return;
    case 254:
      if (fx < 72) r.nextInt(3);
      else if (fx < 108) r.nextInt(2);
      else r.nextInt(4);
      return;
    default:
      if (FURNITURE_DUST.has(sheet)) r.nextInt(3);
  }
}

/** KillTile 生成期语义（cs:63559：尘埃掷循环 cs:63747-51 + 击杀写 cs:63933-65
 *  + 尾部 SquareTileFrame cs:63967） */
function killTileGen(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return;
  const sheet = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  const fx = st.frameX[i]!;
  (globalThis as { __swKillCap?: (x: number, y: number, sheet: number) => void }).__swKillCap?.(x, y, sheet);
  const dust = killTileDustAmount(sheet, fx);
  for (let k = 0; k < dust; k++) makeTileDustRoll(ctx, sheet, fx);
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);          // active=false+half=false+type=0（帧 -1 不可表达）
  squareTileFrame(st, ctx, x, y);
}
/** SquareTileFrame（cs:80924）：九宫列主序，中心 resetFrame=true（178 掷门，永不中） */
function squareTileFrame(st: TileStore, ctx: SweepCtx, x: number, y: number): void {
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x - 1, y + 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y, true);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x, y + 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y - 1, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y, false);
  tileFrameGen(st, ctx, x + 1, y + 1, false);
}
/** PPPP：跨 pass 复用的生成期帧链（WorldUtils 侧 frameNeighbors 支的 1:1 入口）。

  private actuallyPlaceDartTrap(d: DartSpot): void {
    const st = this.st;
    const idx = st.idx(d.trapX, d.trapY);
    st.type[idx] = DART_TRAP;
    st.flags[idx] = 1;
    st.frameX[idx] = d.directionX === -1 ? 18 : 0;
    st.frameY[idx] = 0;
    st.slope[idx] = 0;
    st.half[idx] = 0;
    this.placeWireLine({ x: d.x, y: d.y, dirX: d.directionX, dirY: 0, steps: d.xPush });
  }

  /** PlaceWireLine(cs:534-540):0..steps 含端点 */
  private placeWireLine(w: WireSpot): void {
    const st = this.st;
    for (let i = 0; i <= w.steps; i++) {
      const x = w.x + w.dirX * i, y = w.y + w.dirY * i;
      if (st.inBounds(x, y)) st.wire[st.idx(x, y)] |= WIRE_RED;
    }
  }

  /** ActuallyPlaceBoulderTrap(cs:542-609) */
  private actuallyPlaceBoulderTrap(b: BoulderSpot): void {
    const st = this.st;
    const requiredHeight = 4;   // requiredHeight 恒 4(cs:289)
    for (let i = b.x; i < b.x + 2; i++) {
      for (let j = b.y - requiredHeight; j <= b.y + 2; j++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) continue;
        const idx = st.idx(i, j);
        if (j < b.y - requiredHeight + 2) {
          st.setTileSilent(i, j, 0);                       // ClearTile
        } else if (j <= b.y) {
          if (!st.flags[idx]) {
            st.type[idx] = b.bestType;
            st.flags[idx] = 1;
          }
          st.slope[idx] = 0;
          st.half[idx] = 0;
          st.wire[idx] |= WIRE_RED;
          if (TILE_DEFS[st.type[idx]]?.solid) st.wire[idx] |= WIRE_ACTUATOR;
        } else {
          st.setTileSilent(i, j, 0);                       // ClearTile
        }
      }
    }
    // 6×6 石壳(cs:585-606):非巨石格 → 石头;带线格补致动器
    const cx = b.x + 1, cy = b.y - requiredHeight + 1;
    for (let k = cx - 3; k <= cx + 2; k++) {
      for (let l = cy - 3; l <= cy + 2; l++) {
        if (!st.inBounds(k, l)) continue;
        const idx = st.idx(k, l);
        if (!st.flags[idx]) continue;   // 近似:仅活性格参与(原版对惰性格也写 type)
        if (!BOULDER_TILES.has(st.type[idx])) {
          st.type[idx] = STONE;
          if (st.wire[idx] & 15) st.wire[idx] |= WIRE_ACTUATOR;
        }
      }
    }
    // PlaceTile(cx, cy, 138):巨石(cs:607)——TileObjectData Style2x2 四格分片帧
    // (Tiles_138 36×38 单变体;此前只写锚定格 = 渲染只剩 18×18 小片,同 TrapsPass
    // "贴图不全"根因,2026-08-13)
    if (st.inBounds(cx, cy) && !st.flags[st.idx(cx, cy)]) {
      for (let dy = 0; dy < 2; dy++) {
        for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
          if (st.inBounds(cx + dx, cy + dy)) st.setTileSilent(cx + dx, cy + dy, BOULDER, dx * 18, dy * 18);
        }
      }
    }
    this.placeWireLine({ x: b.x, y: b.y, dirX: 0, dirY: 1, steps: b.yPush });
  }

  /** ActuallyPlaceExplosive(cs:611-619) */
  private actuallyPlaceExplosive(e: { x: number; y: number }): void {
    const st = this.st;
    if (!st.inBounds(e.x, e.y)) return;
    const idx = st.idx(e.x, e.y);
    st.type[idx] = EXPLOSIVES;
    st.flags[idx] = 1;
    st.frameX[idx] = 0;
    st.frameY[idx] = 0;
    st.slope[idx] = 0;
    st.half[idx] = 0;
  }

using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes;

public class ThinIceBiome : MicroBiome
{
	public override bool Place(Point origin, StructureMap structures, GenerationProgress progress)
	{
		Dictionary<ushort, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<ushort, int>();
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(origin.X - 25, origin.Y - 25), new Shapes.Rectangle(50, 50), new Actions.TileScanner(0, 59, 147, 1, 225).Output(dictionary));
		int num = dictionary[0] + dictionary[1];
		int num2 = dictionary[59];
		int num3 = dictionary[147];
		if (dictionary[225] > 0)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (num3 <= num2 || num3 <= num)
		{
			return false;
		}
		int num4 = 0;
		for (int num5 = GenBase._random.Next(10, 15); num5 > 5; num5--)
		{
			int num6 = GenBase._random.Next(-5, 5);
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(origin.X + num6, origin.Y + num4), new Shapes.Circle(num5), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(4), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(147, 161, 224, 0, 1), new Actions.SetTile(162, setSelfFrames: true)));
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(origin.X + num6, origin.Y + num4), new Shapes.Circle(num5), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Blotches(4), new Modifiers.HasLiquid(), new Modifiers.SkipTiles(21, 467, 226, 237), new Actions.SetTile(162, setSelfFrames: true), new Actions.SetLiquid(0, 0)));
			num4 += num5 - 2;
		}
		structures.AddStructure(new Rectangle(origin.X - 25, origin.Y - 25, 50, 50), 8);
		return true;
	}
}

export function placeThinIcePatch(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, ox: number, oy: number,
): boolean {
  // TileScanner 50×50(cs:11-12,origin-25 起):0/1/59/147/225 计数
  let dirtStone = 0, mud = 0, snow = 0, hive = 0;
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 50; dx++) {
    for (let dy = 0; dy < 50; dy++) {
      const x = ox - 25 + dx, y = oy - 25 + dy;
      if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) continue;
      const idx = st.idx(x, y);
      if (!st.flags[idx]) continue;
      const t = st.type[idx];
      if (t === DIRT || t === STONE) dirtStone++;
      else if (t === MUD) mud++;
      else if (t === SNOW_BLOCK) snow++;
      else if (t === HIVE) hive++;
    }
  }
  if (hive > 0) return false;                    // cs:16-18
  if (snow <= mud || snow <= dirtStone) return false;   // cs:19-22
  let num4 = 0;
  // for (num5 = Next(10,15); num5 > 5; num5--)(cs:24-31)
  for (let num5 = rng.int(10, 14); num5 > 5; num5--) {
    const num6 = rng.int(-5, 4);                 // Next(-5, 5)
    const cx = ox + num6, cy = oy + num4;
    // Gen 1:Circle(num5) + Blotches(4) + OnlyTiles(147,161,224,0,1) → SetTile(162)
    forEachCircleCell(st, cx, cy, num5, rng, 4, (x, y) => {
      const idx = st.idx(x, y);
      if (!st.flags[idx] || !ICE_SRC.has(st.type[idx])) return;
      setThinIce(st, idx);
    });
    // Gen 2:Circle(num5) + Blotches(4) + HasLiquid + SkipTiles(21,467,226,237)
    //        → SetTile(162) + SetLiquid(0,0)
    forEachCircleCell(st, cx, cy, num5, rng, 4, (x, y) => {
      const idx = st.idx(x, y);
      if (st.liquid[idx] === 0) return;          // HasLiquid
      if (st.flags[idx] && ICE_SKIP.has(st.type[idx])) return;   // SkipTiles
      setThinIce(st, idx);
      st.liquid[idx] = 0;                        // SetLiquid(0, 0)
      st.liquidType[idx] = 0;
    });
    num4 += num5 - 2;
  }
  // structures.AddStructure((ox-25, oy-25, 50, 50), 8)(cs:32)——★原版是
  // AddStructure（StructureMap.cs:72-79,只入 _structures 不入 _protectedStructures,
  // **不参与 CanPlace 互斥**,仅 GetBoundingBox 消费）。为保持本 pass 原局部互斥
  // 行为（薄冰斑挡后续野营地/矿爆点/剑冢）不回归,仍登记进全局保护图,备案。
  addProtectedStructure(gs, { x0: ox - 25, y0: oy - 25, x1: ox + 25, y1: oy + 25 }, 0);
  return true;
}

/** Shapes.Circle(Shapes.cs:33-49) 行主序 + Modifiers.Blotches(Modifiers.cs:89-137)。
 *  Blotches(scale):先掷 1 次 NextDouble 丢弃,再判 chance=0.3;< 0.3 时掷 4 次
 *  Next 得 blotch 矩形(x∈[-3,0]..[0,3] × y 同),否则单格 */
function forEachCircleCell(
  st: TileStore, cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, rng: RNG, _scale: number,
  apply: (x: number, y: number) => void,
): void {
  void _scale;   // Blotches 尺度恒 4(ThinIceBiome 固定传参)
  const rr = (radius + 1) * (radius + 1);
  for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {
    const num2 = (radius / radius) * dy;   // horizontalRadius == verticalRadius
    const half = Math.min(radius, Math.trunc(Math.sqrt(rr - num2 * num2)));
    for (let dx = -half; dx <= half; dx++) {
      rng.next();                          // Blotches.Apply 丢弃掷
      if (rng.next() < 0.3) {
        const bx0 = rng.int(-3, 0), bx1 = rng.int(0, 3);
        const by0 = rng.int(-3, 0), by1 = rng.int(0, 3);
        for (let bi = bx0; bi <= bx1; bi++) {
          for (let bj = by0; bj <= by1; bj++) {
            const x = cx + dx + bi, y = cy + dy + bj;
            if (st.inBounds(x, y)) apply(x, y);
          }
        }
      } else {
        const x = cx + dx, y = cy + dy;
        if (st.inBounds(x, y)) apply(x, y);
      }
    }
  }

public abstract class GenShape : GenBase
{
	private ShapeData _outputData;

	protected bool _quitOnFail;

	public abstract bool Perform(Point origin, GenAction action);

	protected bool UnitApply(GenAction action, Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
	{
		if (_outputData != null)
		{
			_outputData.Add(x - origin.X, y - origin.Y);
		}
		return action.Apply(origin, x, y, args);
	}

		return this;
	}

	public class SetTile : GenAction
	{
		private ushort _type;

		private bool _doFraming;

		private bool _doNeighborFraming;

		private bool _clearTile;

		public SetTile(ushort type, bool setSelfFrames = false, bool setNeighborFrames = true, bool clearTile = true)
		{
			_type = type;
			_doFraming = setSelfFrames;
			_doNeighborFraming = setNeighborFrames;
			_clearTile = clearTile;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[x, y];
			if (_clearTile)
			{
				tile.Clear(~(TileDataType.Wiring | TileDataType.Actuator));
			}
			tile.type = _type;
			tile.active(active: true);
			if (_doFraming)
			{
				WorldUtils.TileFrame(x, y, _doNeighborFraming);
			}
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}

namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding;

{
	public static Rectangle ClampToWorld(Rectangle tileRectangle, int fluff = 0)
	{
		int num = Math.Max(fluff, Math.Min(tileRectangle.Left, Main.maxTilesX - fluff));

		int num4 = Math.Max(fluff, Math.Min(tileRectangle.Bottom, Main.maxTilesY - fluff));
		return new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2);

	public static Rectangle GetWorldPlayArea()
	{
		int num = 640;

	{

		{
			_types = types;

		{

			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
	}

	public class HasLiquid : GenAction
	{
		private int _liquidType;

		private int _liquidLevel;

		public HasLiquid(int liquidLevel = -1, int liquidType = -1)
		{
			_liquidType = liquidType;
			_liquidLevel = liquidLevel;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			Tile tile = GenBase._tiles[x, y];
			if ((_liquidType == -1 || _liquidType == tile.liquidType()) && ((_liquidLevel == -1 && tile.liquid != 0) || _liquidLevel == tile.liquid))
			{
				return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
			}
			return Fail();
		}
	}

	public static bool CheckAndAdjustMultiDirectionalTile(int i, int j, int type, out int newFrameDirection)
	{
		newFrameDirection = 0;
		if (!InWorld(i, j, 2))
		{
			return false;
		}
		Tile tile = Main.tile[i, j - 1];
		Tile tile2 = Main.tile[i, j + 1];
		Tile tile3 = Main.tile[i - 1, j];
		Tile tile4 = Main.tile[i + 1, j];
		int num = -1;
		int num2 = -1;
		int num3 = -1;
		int num4 = -1;
		if (ValidAnchorForMultiDirectionalTile(i, j - 1, tile, 0))
		{
			num2 = tile.type;
		}
		if (ValidAnchorForMultiDirectionalTile(i, j + 1, tile2, 1))
		{
			num = tile2.type;
		}
		if (ValidAnchorForMultiDirectionalTile(i - 1, j, tile3, 2))
		{
			num3 = tile3.type;
		}
		if (ValidAnchorForMultiDirectionalTile(i + 1, j, tile4, 3))
		{
			num4 = tile4.type;
		}
		if (num >= 0 && Main.tileSolid[num] && !Main.tileSolidTop[num])
		{
			newFrameDirection = 0;
			return true;
		}
		if (num3 >= 0 && Main.tileSolid[num3] && !Main.tileSolidTop[num3])
		{
			newFrameDirection = 2;
			return true;
		}
		if (num4 >= 0 && Main.tileSolid[num4] && !Main.tileSolidTop[num4])
		{
			newFrameDirection = 3;
			return true;
		}
		if (num2 >= 0 && Main.tileSolid[num2] && !Main.tileSolidTop[num2])
		{
			newFrameDirection = 1;
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public static void KillWall(int i, int j, bool fail = false)
	{
		if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= Main.maxTilesX || j >= Main.maxTilesY)
		{
			return;
		}
		Tile tile = Main.tile[i, j];
		if (tile == null)

			tile = new Tile();
			Main.tile[i, j] = tile;
		}
		if (tile.wall <= 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		fail = KillWall_CheckFailure(fail, tile);
		KillWall_PlaySounds(i, j, tile);
		int num = 10;

			num = 3;

function solidAllowTop(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return true;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i] || (st.wire[i] & 32)) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d || !(genSolidType(st.type[i]) || SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]] === 380)) return false;
  const sh = SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]];
  const plat = PLATFORMS.has(sh);
  const bottomSlope = st.slope[i] === 3 || st.slope[i] === 4;
  return (!plat && !bottomSlope) || (plat && st.half[i] !== 0);
}
/** SolidTileAllowLeftSlope（cs:70345）/ RightSlope（cs:70365） */
function solidAllowSide(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, side: 'L' | 'R'): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return true;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i] || (st.wire[i] & 32)) return false;
  const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]];
  if (!d || !genSolidType(st.type[i]) || st.half[i]) return false;
  if (PLATFORMS.has(SWEEP_SHEET[st.type[i]])) return false;
  const sl = st.slope[i];
  return side === 'L' ? sl !== 2 : sl !== 1;
}
/** SolidTile2（cs:70178）：active && tileSolid && slope==0 && !half && !inActive。
 *  ★原版 Main.tileSolid 对平台族{19,427,435-439}=true（tileSolidTop 同时真）——
 *  本仓 TILE_DEFS.platform 格 solid=false,须按 sheet 集补真（陶罐 CheckPot 实证:
 *  平台上的陶罐 vanilla 存活）。tileSolid 主体走 genSolidType（RRRR，同上）。 */

const WALL_LARGE_FRAMES = new Set([224, 323, 324, 325, 326, 327, 328, 329, 330, 179, 146, 147, 167, 354]);
/** Framing.WallFrame 掷门（cs:...）：resetFrame=true 且 wall>0 且
 *  wallLargeFrames[wall]==0 → 1×Next(0,3)（wall==21 再 1×Next(2)）。 */
function wallFrameRoll(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
  if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || x >= st.w - 1 || y >= st.h - 1) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  const wl = st.wall[i]!;
  if (wl === 0 || WALL_LARGE_FRAMES.has(wl)) return;
  rng.nextInt(3);
  if (wl === 21) rng.nextInt(2);
}

}

  flipGenSolid([162], true);
}

/** WebsInSpiderCavesAndHoney pass（L20140）1:1：
 *  墙86 蜂巢腔 → 液体转蜂蜜 + 1/3 钟乳石(165)；墙62 蜘蛛巢 → 清液体 +
 *  空格 9/10 放蛛网 51（±2-4 内有实心才放） */
export function runWebsInSpiderCavesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  for (let i = 100; i < st.w - 100; i++) {
    for (let j = Math.floor(gs.worldSurface); j < st.h - 100; j++) {
      const idx = st.idx(i, j);
      if (st.wall[idx] === 86) {
        if (st.liquid[idx] > 0) st.liquidType[idx] = 3; // honey
        if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
          // PlaceTight(spiders:false) → PlaceUncheckedStalactite（cs:38373-38402）：
          // 帧按上方实心块类型分派——蜂巢腔内上方必是蜂巢块 225 → 蜂蜜滴单格
          // fx=162+变体×18（162/180/198）、fy=72。此前错用雪地冰锥帧(0..36, 双格 fy 0/18)
          // ——蜂巢里挂出一串冰锥的根因
          if (solidTile(st, i, j - 1) && st.inBounds(i, j) && !st.flags[st.idx(i, j)]
            && st.inBounds(i, j + 1) && !st.flags[st.idx(i, j + 1)]) {
            const fx = 162 + rng.int(0, 2) * 18;
            st.setTileSilent(i, j, DECO165, fx, 72);
          }
        }
      }
      if (st.wall[idx] === 62) {
        st.liquid[idx] = 0; st.liquidType[idx] = 0;
      }
      if (st.wall[idx] === 62 && !st.flags[idx] && rng.int(0, 9) !== 0) {
        const r = rng.int(2, 4);
        let nearSolid = false;
        for (let k = i - r; k <= i + r && !nearSolid; k++) {
          for (let l = j - r; l <= j + r; l++) {
            if (solidTile(st, k, l)) { nearSolid = true; break; }
          }
        }
        if (nearSolid) st.setTileSilent(i, j, COBWEB, 0, 0);
      }
    }
  }
}

/** Webs pass（L13659）1:1：w*h*0.0006 次天花板蛛网 runner（前 numMCaves 次锚定山洞口）。
 *  TileRunner(51, addTile:true, ±1 横速, -1 升速, 4-10 半径, 2-3 步) */
export function runWebsPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {  const count = Math.floor(st.w * st.h * 0.0006);
  const numMCaves = gs.numMCaves ?? 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    let j = rng.int(20, st.w - 21);
    let num = rng.int(Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceHigh), st.h - 21);
    if (i < numMCaves && gs.mCaveX && gs.mCaveY) {
      j = gs.mCaveX[i]; num = gs.mCaveY[i];
    }
    if (!st.inBounds(j, num) || st.flags[st.idx(j, num)]) continue;
    if (!(num > gs.worldSurface || st.wall[st.idx(j, num)] > 0)) continue;
    while (num > Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow) && !st.flags[st.idx(j, num)]) num--;
    num++;
    const dir = rng.int(0, 1) === 0 ? -1 : 1;
    while (j > 10 && j < st.w - 10 && !st.flags[st.idx(j, num)]) j += dir;
    j -= dir;
    if (!st.inBounds(j, num)) continue;
    if (!(num > gs.worldSurface || st.wall[st.idx(j, num)] > 0)) continue;
    tileRunner(st, rng, gs, j, num, {
      strength: rng.int(4, 10), steps: rng.int(2, 3), type: COBWEB,
      addTile: true, speedX: dir, speedY: -1,
    });
  }
}

function spreadSpider(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, x: number, y: number): void {
  const __v = (globalThis as { __swSpiderVisit?: (cx: number, cy: number, kind: string, before: number, after: number, wave: number) => void }).__swSpiderVisit;

  let frontier: Array<[number, number]> = [[x, y]];

  let waveN = 0;
  while (frontier.length) {
    const layer = frontier;
    frontier = [];
    for (const [cx, cy] of layer) {
      if (cx < 1 || cx >= st.w - 1 || cy < 1 || cy >= st.h - 1) continue;
      if (cy >= st.h - 200 - rng.int(0, 4)) continue; // Main.UnderworldLayer(h-200) - Next(5)
      if (cy < gs.worldSurface + rng.int(0, 4)) continue;
      seen.add(key(cx, cy));
      const i = st.idx(cx, cy);
      const before = (st.flags[i] ? 1 : 0) | (st.wall[i] ? 2 : 0) | (st.liquid[i] ? 4 : 0);
      if (solidTile(st, cx, cy) || wallSealed(st.wall[i])) {
        if (st.flags[i] && !wallSealed(st.wall[i])) st.wall[i] = 62;
        __v?.(cx, cy, 'S', before, before | 2, waveN);
        continue;
      }
      st.wall[i] = 62;
      rng.nextInt(3);   // SquareWallFrame(cx,cy) 中心格 WallFrame(resetFrame:true)（cs:3682）
      if (!st.flags[i]) {
        st.liquid[i] = 0; st.liquidType[i] = 0;
        if (solidTile(st, cx, cy + 1) && rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
          if (rng.int(0, 14) === 0) {
            // notNearOtherChests:true(cs:3708 原版实参)——±25×±8 已有 BasicChest 则拒
            placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, cx, cy, { style: 15, loot: 'vi_939_web_slinger', notNearOtherChests: true });
          } else {
            placePot(st, rng, cx, cy, rng.int(19, 20));
          }
        }
        if (!st.flags[i]) {
          if (solidTile(st, cx, cy - 1) && rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
            placeTightWebs(st, rng, cx, cy);
          } else if (solidTile(st, cx, cy + 1)) {
            placeDeco187(st, rng, cx, cy, 9 + rng.int(0, 4));
            if (rng.int(0, 2) === 0) {
              if (!st.flags[i]) placeSmallPile(st, cx, cy, 34 + rng.int(0, 3), 1);
              if (!st.flags[i]) placeSmallPile(st, cx, cy, 48 + rng.int(0, 5), 0);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      const after = (st.flags[i] ? 1 : 0) | (st.wall[i] ? 2 : 0) | (st.liquid[i] ? 4 : 0);
      __v?.(cx, cy, 'A', before, after, waveN);
      for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS) {

      }
    }

  }
}

export function runSpiderNestPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {

  //   存档时间线——原版由 UndergroundJungleTrees 头（cs:17956,本仓缺该 pass,备案）还原。
  flipGenSolid([379], false);
  const __m = (globalThis as { __swSpiderNest?: (s: string) => void }).__swSpiderNest;
  const count = Math.floor(st.w * 0.005);
  const retryCap = Math.floor(st.w / 2);
  const yMin = Math.floor((gs.worldSurface + gs.rockLevel) / 2);
  for (let n = 0; n < count; n++) {
    let x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
    let y = rng.int(yMin, st.h - 231);
    let c = countTiles(st, x, y);
    let tries = 0;
    while ((c.count >= MAX_TILE_COUNT || c.count < 500) && tries < retryCap) {
      tries++;
      // cs:17502-17504：重掷 x 仍 [200,w-200)，y 换 [rockLayer+30, h-230)
      x = rng.int(200, st.w - 201);
      y = rng.int(gs.rockLevel + 30, st.h - 231);
      c = countTiles(st, x, y);
      if (c.shroom > 1) c.count = 0;
    }
    __m?.(`NEST#${n} x=${x} y=${y} count=${c.count} shroom=${c.shroom} tries=${tries}`);
    if (tries < retryCap) spreadSpider(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y);
  }
  // ★pass 尾 tileSolid 翻转（cs:17521 `Main.tileSolid[162] = true`）：薄冰回实心
  //   （FragileIce cs:16783 曾翻非实心）——此后 UndergroundHouses 头（cs:17077）与
  //   LihzahrdTemplePart2 头（cs:17813）会再各自翻转。本仓 SpiderNest 槽在薄冰之后,
  //   时序与原版一致（FragileIce 16756 < SpiderCaves 17455）。
  flipGenSolid([162], true);
}

interface LootCtx { rng: RNG; gs: GenState; gy: number; flags: ChestFlags; mainKey: string | null; worldH: number }

/**
 * AddBuriedChest 战利品主体(cs:36283-37360)1:1:按深度四分支。
 * mainVanillaId>0 → 主题主件(冰箱/沙箱/常春藤/水箱/地狱/金字塔等),
 * 否则按分支掷默认主件;各分支再按原版顺序逐项掷概率杂物表。
 */
export function rollChestLoot(ctx: LootCtx, mainVanillaId: number): Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> {
  const { rng, gs, gy, flags } = ctx;
  const bars = barIds(gs);
  const out: Array<{ id: number; stack: number }> = [];
  const push = (v: number, stack = 1) => {
    const id = vid(v);
    if (id >= 0 && out.length < 40) out.push({ id, stack });

function placeTightWebs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  const gi = st.idx(x, y);
  if (st.liquid[gi] > 0 && st.liquidType[gi] === 4) return false;   // anyShimmer（+1 编码 4）
  if (st.flags[gi] && st.type[gi] === LARVA) return false;          // cs:38345 type==231
  const preferSmall = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;   // PlaceTight cs:38338 Next(2)==0
  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);
  if (!solidTile(st, x, y - 1)) return false;
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return false;
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y + 1) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y + 1)]) return false;
  const fx = 108 + variation * 18;
  if (preferSmall) {
    // PlaceUncheckedStalactite 小型分支（IL +0063-009B）：单格 (x,y)，frameY=54
    st.setTileSilent(x, y, DECO165, fx, 54);
    st.slope[st.idx(x, y)] = 0; st.half[st.idx(x, y)] = 0;
    return true;
  }
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, DECO165, fx, 0);
  st.setTileSilent(x, y + 1, DECO165, fx, 18);
  st.slope[st.idx(x, y)] = 0; st.half[st.idx(x, y)] = 0;            // ClearSlope（cs:38382）
  st.slope[st.idx(x, y + 1)] = 0; st.half[st.idx(x, y + 1)] = 0;
  checkStalactite(st, rng, x, y);                                   // cs:38353 尾部复核
  return true;
}
